Most dragons found in Faerun fall into one of two general categories: Chromatic dragons, so called because their scales are of clear and distinctive colors, who are almost always evil, and Metallic Dragons…

items.Name: Zagash's Helm
items.Description: Hans Kludgen spent his life assisting the arch-mage Cledos. He traveled for many years across the world to hunt for arcane components to assist Cledos in the wizard's many rituals. Cledos rewarded Hans one fateful day by decapitating the faithful assistant and through a rare rit…

items.Name: Key
items.Description: This key perhaps opens the nearby chest.

items.Name: Zagash's Rod of Negative Energy
items.Description: Zagash gave you this rod with the suggestion that it might be useful for healing any injuries he suffers while accompanying you, since as an undead creature he cannot make use of normal healing magic.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Burst (10) Cast Spell 4 Charges/Use
Negative Energy Ray (5) Cast Spell 2 Uses/Day

items.Name: Zap Axe
items.Description: Zapalo was a gnomish smith with some aptitude as a mage as well. He attempted to apply his talents to the construction of a powerful magical battleaxe that could be used by the militia guarding his community. He hoped to create a truly magnificent weapon, but like many gnomes he…

items.Name: Zemquin's Zapper
items.Description:
This strange little contraption was built by the gnomish inventor Bliffmin Zemquin. It appears to be a portable device capable of applying electric charges in various ways.

NOTE: The unique power of this item can render a targeted melee weapon or stack of projectiles (only - th…
PropertiesDecoded: Gedlee's Electric Loop (3) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: Zarala's Bard Costume
items.Description: According to Zarala, this outfit once belonged to her mother, a powerful sorceress. It is somehow tied to the magic inherent in Zarala's bloodline, and even if she were willing to relinquish it, it could not be easily used by anyone else. Zarala also claims that she has yet to f…

items.Name: Zarala's Bard Costume (Wrecked)
items.Description: Struck by a Bebilith's ruinous power, Zarala's armor has been damaged, but it seems the magic it contains was too powerful to allow its complete destruction. It even appears to be slowly regenerating! Likely it is only a matter of time before it is restored to its original state…

items.Name: Zarala's Belt
items.Description: This magical belt, which infuses the wearer with strength and vitality, was taken from the treasury of magical artifacts accumulated by Hamad Galhadr during his time as an adventurer, and made available to his daughter in the hope it would aid in keeping her alive.

items.Name: Zarala's Crossbow
items.Description: Zarala purchased this crossbow from Saman. It is noteworthy for its ability to magically produce new bolts to fire.

items.Name: Zarala's Cloak
items.Description: According to Zarala, this cloak was part of an outfit once belonging to her mother, a powerful sorceress. It apparently enhances a genasi's connection to, and ability to safely deal with, magical and elemental forces. As a result, it could not be easily used by just anyone even …

items.Name: Zarala's Letter to Kadzia
items.Description: This letter and package of research notes was given you by Zarala to take to her friend Kadzia Zekar.

items.Name: Zarala's Letter to Inas Senkhar
items.Description: This letter and package of research notes was given you by Zarala to take to the historian Inas Senkhar.

items.Name: Assassin's Note
items.Description:
Someone has written the following on this note:

"It has come to my attention that the Galhadr girl has begun researching matters better left alone, and has been sending some lackey around gathering information from people like Inas Senkhar. It would be best to put a stop to thi…

items.Name: Tome of Zataroth
items.Description: This tome once belonged to the great Calishite wizard Zataroth. It doubtless contains much magical lore, and would be very valuable to an arcane spellcaster. Its covers have been magically sealed, however, preventing you from reading it.

items.Name: Zataroth's Notes on Magical Research
items.Description: A collection of notes and papers made by Zataroth concerning various magical experiments and studies he was involved in. It provides a wealth of information about magical theory and spell-casting.

items.Name: Zataroth's Green Gem
items.Description: This green gem glows softly with a strange magical light. You suspect it may have some special purpose.

items.Name: Zataroth's Blue Gem
items.Description: This blue gem glows softly with a strange magical light. You suspect it may have some special purpose.

items.Name: Zataroth's White Gem
items.Description: This white gem glows softly with a strange magical light. You suspect it may have some special purpose.

items.Name: Zataroth's Red Gem
items.Description: This red gem glows softly with a strange magical light. You suspect it may have some special purpose.

items.Name: Zataroth's Rainbow Gem
items.Description: This strange gem is covered with multi-colored bands, and glows softly with a strange magical light. You suspect it may have some special purpose.

items.Name: Reagent Package
items.Description: Stuffed into this bottle are various magical reagents gathered by the aboleth Azoophun, who believed they might be useful in reassembling the Sword of Zefad. Zarala took them with her in the hope that she might be able to make use of them once she learns more about the methods f…

items.Name: Sword of Zefad
items.Description: This ancient sword was wielded in the wars between the djinn and efreet once waged in what is now the nation of Calimshan. It has the power to open rifts to various elemental planes, allowing the wielder to channel enormous power, simultaneously allowing him to deal damage, and …
PropertiesDecoded: Summon Creature IX (17) Cast Spell 3 Uses/Day
Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Sword of Zefad (Broken)
items.Description: These are the broken pieces of the Sword of Zefad, a mighty magical blade once wielded by the djinni for which it was named, an ancestor of Zarala. It is potentially a very powerful weapon in her hands, but it would first have to be reforged. You wonder if that is possible.

items.Name: Sword of Zefad (Reforged)
items.Description:
The reforged sword of Zefad. It is said to be one of the few weapons in Faerun able to harm the mighty Tanar'ri Azghulkar, and it is indeed an exceptionally powerful weapon, especially against extraplanar foes.

The reforged version of the sword appears to be shorter than it use…

Outsider Enhancement Bonus vs. Racial Group +8

items.Name: Zekar Estate Key - Underground Chamber
items.Description: This key unlocks the door leading into the Dark Calimport chamber directly underneath the Zekar Estate.

items.Name: Zombie Armor
items.Description: Only tattered bits and pieces remain of what was once a complete suit of armor.
